span_method: Deterministic presentation replay on the single demo excerpt; not live inference or accuracy scoring
ruff_release: F checks pass, same gate as v0.2.0
manual_security_review: No new network endpoint, remote fetching, model request or dependency.
Queue text uses fixed templates; source, reasons, title and URL are Markdown/HTML escaped.
Sample changes only editable inputs, explicitly chooses live Gemma, returns no predictions.
Inputs and quick-start locked during inference; changes clear stale output.
Reports remain local unencrypted temporary files, as documented; only synthetic profiles captured.
Original MIT and separate Gemma/source terms preserved; full source cache stays ignored.
limitations: Scoped pattern and code review, not a penetration test, full dependency audit or proof of absence of all secrets.
